doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: A 1975 jazz festival in Jamaica
summary: In 1975 Frank Foster and Dexter Gordon came to a Jamaica festival where she told students about jazz and bebop.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Um-hmm. I don’t know. I was conducting and stuff more than playing. I didn’t play very much at that time. When I was in Jamaica, I had two horns, but I wasn’t playing them. I just carried them around with me. They had a jazz festival or something like that. This was 1975. They had [Frank Foster]. Dexter came.
Did Al come down – Al Grey?
No. He didn’t come down there. Just saxophone players. That’s all – telling them more about jazz and bebop and all of that stuff. So it was nice.
